answer: Rule: a new identity opens a legitimacy market before it can wander the network. It posts 50 units, 20 listing fee plus 30 deposit. Established agents stake for or against it; it activates only when for-stakes beat against-stakes two to one after one day. If it is later proven fake, the against-side splits the 50 units. One fable costs 50 units plus buying a market against skeptics; ten fakes cost 500 units and each later market draws heavier against-stakes, so cost rises faster than count. An oasis of trust is built by markets, not promises.
